# Cat Mafia (`cat_mafia`)

Fork of `daloniil_test` (Wok Fury) for the Cat Mafia prototype.

`daloniil_test` is left unchanged. All Cat Mafia work happens in this app.

## Commands

```bash
# from third_party/web-sdk
pnpm --filter cat_mafia dev          # → http://localhost:3008
pnpm --filter cat_mafia storybook    # → http://localhost:6008
pnpm --filter cat_mafia build
```

## Identity

| Field   | Value            |
|---------|------------------|
| Package | `cat_mafia`      |
| Game ID | `0_0_cat_mafia`  |
| Title   | Cat Mafia        |
